definitions.explanation: Different from what is ordinary; having distinctive characteristics.

{特殊|とくしゅ}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧。
examples.english: A movie that uses special effects.

notes:
{特殊|とくしゅ} describes something special or out of the ordinary.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {特殊|とくしゅ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧: special, unique
- {特殊|とくしゅ}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: special effects
- {特殊|とくしゅ}⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧: special forces
- {特殊|とくしゅ}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧: special ability
- {特殊|とくしゅ}⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧: special circumstances

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {特殊|とくしゅ}: special, unique (unusual)
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧: special (exceptional treatment)
- ⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧: general, ordinary
